scopedCoverageNotes.text: All154English2026General sample PDFs linked by the official Honolulu-filtered state index were acquired and all616native pages reviewed for candidate headings. Exactly two local candidate fields occur: councilDistrictIV in19styles and DistrictVI in17styles; four printed names and full fields agree everywhere. Remaining118styles have no local candidate field. County coverage here means the complete current published English sample set; other translations were not separately compared.

Both active local contest IDs and allfour candidate IDs/core fields already exist in the held HI input. This packet refreshes their evidence only and mints zero active offices/people. Current official report independently marks allfour InGeneral. Existing statewide/federal/legislative/OHA records, other counties and allmeasures/explanations remain unchanged. OHA island-residency labels are not narrowed to county-only electorates.

The current official county inventory schedules councilII/IV/VI/VIII in2026. Official report explicitly marks WEYER,Matt inDistrictII and OKIMOTO,ValAquino inDistrictVIII ElectedAfterPrimary; those records remain in separate declared-elected.json and are not Novemberactive contests. Six other filings retain exact Issued/InPrimary statuses without an invented withdrawal/cancellation label.

Hawaii official election rules state there is no provision for write-in voting. No blank slot is a person, and no named write-in is created. All sample acquisition used public index/PDF routes; CSVexport was a read-only public report action. No registered-voter identity was used.

Exact councilDistrict4/6 electorate keys are preserved and require reader geography matching; neither HonoluluCDP nor entireCityandCounty replaces a council district. Candidate facts are ready; reader delivery remains for parent/River to verify.
